description: Source code for parsing and managing Certificate Revocation List (CRL) sets in Chromium, including reading headers, serials, and verifying SPKI hashes.

classes.name: CRLSet
classes.description: Represents a set of Certificate Revocation Lists (CRLs) with methods for parsing, validation, and testing.

methods.name: ReadHeader
methods.description: Reads the header from data, extracts JSON header information, and updates data to remove the header.

methods.name: ReadCRL
methods.description: Reads a CRL entry from data, extracting parent SPKI hash and serial numbers.

methods.name: CopyHashListFromHeader
methods.description: Extracts a list of base64-encoded SHA-256 hashes from header JSON.

methods.name: CopyHashToHashesMapFromHeader
methods.description: Extracts a map of base64-encoded SHA-256 hashes to lists of hashes from header JSON.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a CRLSet from binary data, validating header and CRL entries.

methods.name: CheckSPKI
methods.description: Checks if a given SPKI hash is revoked.

methods.name: CheckSubject
methods.description: Checks if a subject and SPKI hash are revoked based on limited subjects.

methods.name: CheckSerial
methods.description: Checks if a serial number is revoked for a given issuer SPKI hash.

methods.name: IsKnownInterceptionKey
methods.description: Determines if a SPKI hash is a known interception key.

methods.name: IsExpired
methods.description: Checks if the CRL set has expired based on 'NotAfter' timestamp.

methods.name: sequence
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of the CRL set.

methods.name: CrlsForTesting
methods.description: Returns the internal CRL list for testing purposes.

methods.name: BuiltinCRLSet
methods.description: Returns a built-in, default CRL set.

methods.name: EmptyCRLSetForTesting
methods.description: Returns an empty CRL set for testing.

methods.name: ExpiredCRLSetForTesting
methods.description: Returns an expired CRL set for testing.

methods.name: ForTesting
methods.description: Creates a CRL set with specified test parameters.
